prompt.value: Consider the following snippet of code and answer the given sub-questions. (Note: the built-in function isinstance(object, type) is used to check if an object is of a specified type.)
Which of the following changes would also include SQL in the final result?

options.value: Make the length condition len(item) % 2 == 1 instead of == 0.
Ensure 'sql' is written as 'SQL' in the original list.

explanation.value: 'sql' has length 3 (odd). Changing the test to len%2==1 lets it through -> 'SQL'. Removing the length condition entirely also lets every string through -> 'SQL'. Writing 'SQL' originally keeps length 3, still failing len%2==0. Removing isinstance(str) does not help because len%2==0 still fails for length 3. So only options 1 and 2 include SQL.
